entries.title: Use a custom connection on your other computers
entries.body: A custom connection in Settings → Intelligence offers Use for each computer that runs work. You type that computer's own key, it checks each model and keeps the key, and this computer keeps no copy. A later name or price change reaches it at once, a changed limit checks the model again there, and a new address or header pauses it there until you approve it again.

picture.alt: Settings → Intelligence with a custom connection offering Use as Builder under its models
